line_verbatim: Daubentonia madagascariensis solid food: 3 mo; nl 11821

The rare, nocturnal aye-aye Daubentonia madagascariensis from Madagascar eats fruit, flowers, and insect larvae. Males of this 2.5-3 kg, solitary and arboreal omnivore have scrotal testes, extremely small seminal vesicles, large Cowper’s glands, and a baculum (5572, 8163, 8444)
